summary: Public projects created on 10 April 2026: 12 repos.
intro: Agent plugins and templates for research workspaces and deliberation systems, plus an index of LLM Council projects. Geopolitical forecasting tools cover Iran and Israel conflict scenarios. Other repositories include a Google Workspace MCP server and MCP deployment notes.

projects.name: Awesome LLM Council Projects
projects.description: Index of projects based upon Karpathy's LLM Council model

projects.name: Brainstorm Solutions Plugin
projects.description: When you hit a wall during development, spin up a dedicated research workspace to brainstorm your way through it.

projects.name: Council Of Maniacs
projects.description: A deliberation system where 8 wildly unhinged AI personas debate your questions. Same model, different system prompts, maximum chaos.

projects.name: Geopol Forecasts Index
projects.description: Index of prediction runs from Geopol Forecaster with accuracy tracking. Snowglobe + LLM Council pipeline.

projects.name: Google Workspace MCP
projects.description: Multi-workspace Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, Contacts, Drive, Docs, Sheets. Forked from dguido/google-workspace-mcp.

projects.name: Iran Israel Ceasefire Prediction 090426
projects.description: Open-sourced geopolitical forecast: Iran-Israel-US ceasefire durability assessment (09/04/2026). Two-stage pipeline (Snowglobe + LLM Council) with 38-actor simulation and 6-lens analytical panel.

projects.name: Iran Israel Conflict Trajectory 240326
projects.description: An open-sourced geopolitical forecast run produced by Geopol Forecaster.

projects.name: Iran Regime Change Forecast 1004
projects.description: Geopol Forecaster run: probability of forced regime change in Iran (+1 week / +1 month / +1 year). 10-actor simulation + 6-lens council. Headline: <1% / 1-3% / 4-9%.

projects.name: LLM Council Template
projects.description: Template for creating LLM Council apps - multi-model deliberation with peer review and synthesis. Based on karpathy/llm-council.

projects.name: Local Claude Plugin Install Research
projects.description: A template for conducting iterative AI-assisted research using Claude Code as the execution engine.

projects.name: MCP Deployment Architecture
projects.description: MCP architectural deployment notes, periodically updated
